## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes #https://github.ibm.com/contextforge-org/mcp-context-forge/issues/120

---

## 📝 Summary
Implements comprehensive container security hardening to address all vulnerabilities identified during penetration testing. This PR adds defense-in-depth security measures following CIS Docker Benchmark best practices.


1. **NoNewPrivileges** - Prevents privilege escalation via setuid/sudo
2. **ReadOnlyRootFilesystem** - Enabled with tmpfs mounts for required writable directories
3. **AppArmor/SELinux** - Mandatory Access Control (MAC) profile enabled
4. **Privileged Mode** - Explicitly disabled to maintain container isolation
5.  Added a make target to verify if the containers start up with added security
